verdict.rationale: The official LangGraph CLI builds and runs the Agent Server locally from the terminal, exposing run/thread endpoints that an agent could call to exercise a graph. Graphs also expose sync/async stream methods, so they can be driven from a script. However, nothing shows bundled example agents or a one-shot headless run command for verifying output; verification has to go through a local server or custom scripting. Missing for 10: documented example agents runnable from the CLI, a direct headless run/invoke command with inspectable output, hands-on corroboration of a terminal verification loop.
